messages:
marta: FYI post-launch issue on celerity7b (qlora 4-bit): observed premature token truncation on long instruction prompts. not consistent across seeds though.
jin: do you have a short repro?
marta: yes, small one below. it cuts off mid-sentence around 350-420 tokens depending on batch.
marta: ```python
# repro snippet
from redwood_api import Client
client = Client(model='celerity7b-qlora-4bit')
prompt = 'Write a long essay about climate policy. Make it ~800 tokens and include an opening summary.'
resp = client.generate(prompt, max_tokens=800, temperature=0.0)
print(resp.text)
```
eli: saw something similar on a canary earlier but assumed it was kv-cache eviction with our runtime batching. can you paste raw response end?
marta: pasted. ends with "...in summary, the policy should be" and then stops. no trailing \n or partial token artifacts.
jin: hmm. which runtime and kernel? gpu type?
marta: runtime: rwd-infer-v3, kernel: fused-attn-v2, nodes on p4d.
priya: did we enable the post-quantization fusion optimizations? those can sometimes change tokenization boundaries in corner cases.
marta: yes q-fuse=on. if I disable q-fuse locally (using dev flag) the issue goes away.
jin: that's a strong hint. can we get model logits at the truncation point? maybe a -inf spike or EOS token probability bump.
marta: grabbed logits dump: last tokens show EOS prob jumping from 0.02 -> 0.9 in one step.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026 - celerity7b 4-bit truncation on long prompts. assigned to eng-ml.
eli: is this unique to 4-bit qlora or also in 8-bit or fp16?
marta: fp16 and int8 (8-bit) look fine on same runtime. 4-bit qlora reproduces consistently.
priya: could be quantization bias interacting with fused kernel numerical differences. back-of-envelope: 4-bit weight rounding + fused attn accumulation precision -> EOS amplification.
jin: action plan: 1) add targeted eval to onboarding checks for long-instruction generation (>= 700 tokens) 2) temporarily disable q-fuse for celerity7b 4-bit in hosted catalog 3) gather logits and inputs and link to INC-2026 4) triage if we can adjust quantization calibration (per-channel or clipping)
marta: started a quick canary: disabling q-fuse on a small subset of hosts. results show stable runs for the same prompts.
eli: good. can we keep a canary with 1% traffic on q-fuse off and rollback the rollout?
priya: also add a unit in the quant experiments notebook that tests EOS-prob stability across sequence length; this would catch similar regressions earlier.
jin: long-term: coordinate with runtime team to check fused-attn numerics under low-bit quantization. might need accumulator in fp32 or compensation fix.
marta: I'll attach sample logs and the logits dump to INC-2026.
ops-bot: INC-2026 updated: marta added 3 attachments (repro.py, logits_dump.json, canary_results.csv).
eli: tagging @runtime-team in the ticket.
priya: priority: P1 for hosted customers using celerity7b-4bit. not a platform-wide outage but correctness impact is high.
jin: who will do the quant calibration experiment? I can run a per-channel recalibration sweep tomorrow.
marta: assigning to jin. I'll update the onboarding checklist doc to require long-run pass on quant variant before GA.
eli: small note: add a test for "EOS-prob jump > 0.5 within one token" as a heuristic.
marta: agreed. also add a regression alert in Redwood Console: if ephemeral model variant shows >0.1% truncated outputs vs baseline, send pager.
priya: can we also surface this in the model catalog UI as a "known issue" flag for the 4-bit variant until resolved?
jin: yep, I'll add a temp note.
marta: thanks team. will follow up in INC-2026 and close the canary if q-fuse off remains green. \neli: thanks, good catch. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: canalery rollout reverted for celerity7b-qlora-4bit (1% -> 0%).
